sources.P28-A: Boghosian, Devitt-Lee, Johnson, Marcq & Wang 2017, Physica A 476:15, Eq. (61)

implementation_choices: P28-A model: YardSale(n_agents=5000, f, lambda_save=0, chi=tau*f^2, redistribute_every=2500, w0=1.0, init_mode='equal', seed); advanced only by step(2500), so each tax (w <- (1-chi) w + chi mean) follows its own 2500 transactions. Time per step(2500) = 2 f^2 * 2500 / 5000 = f^2 in tau-bar units.

Burn-in max(20/tau, 20) tau-bar = round(t_burn / f^2) blocks; measurement 50 tau-bar = round(50 / f^2) blocks; the Gini of the state returned by each step(2500) (i.e. after that block's tax) is sampled every block.
Per-seed estimate = time average of the sampled Gini over the measurement window; reported value = mean over the 10 seeds, SE = sd/sqrt(10).

Stationarity rule, applied to every P28-A run set (each tau, f, init): first-half and second-half time averages are formed per seed; the rule compares their 10-seed means. If they differ by more than 0.005, all 10 seeds of that set are rerun once with the burn-in doubled, and the rerun replaces the set (no further doubling). Per-seed half differences are also reported.

Finite-f check: tau = 0.5 at f = 0.025 (chi = 3.125e-4, R = 2500), seeds 2801-2810, same tau-bar burn-in and window. If |G(0.05) - G(0.025)| > 0.01 (seed means), f = 0.025 is run at all three tau and the gated value at each tau is the linear extrapolation in f^2 to 0: G0 = G(0.025) + (G(0.025) - G(0.05)) * 0.025^2 / (0.05^2 - 0.025^2).
Reported, not gated: tau = 0.5, f = 0.05, init_mode='exponential', seeds 2801-2810.

P28-B model: YardSale(n_agents=50000, f=0.25, lambda_save=0, chi=0, w0=100, init_mode='equal', seed), seeds 2821-2830, advanced in step(1e6) batches; the 16 equally spaced times are t = k * 5e6, k = 1..16 (up to 8e7).

P28-B estimator: A(w) = fraction of agents with wealth > w, evaluated at every agent's wealth; least-squares fit A = alpha + beta ln w over agents with 0.2 <= A <= 0.8; ln w_min = (1 - alpha)/beta; a from Eq. (37) w_min = (W/2a) csch(N/2a) exp(-N/2a) with W = 5e6 and N = 5e4, solved in log form ln w_min = ln W - ln a - N/a - ln(1 - exp(-N/a)) (brentq on ln a); per seed, least squares of 1/a on t (t in transactions) gives slope and intercept; the rule uses the mean slope over the 10 seeds.

reported_only.P28_B: reported separately; does not gate the P28 verdict
